summary: Two fades that showed their edges. Header's affix fade variant painted its ramp in the page's solid ground under a bar that is the page at 90%, so the strip just below the bar was MORE opaque than the bar — a bright seam exactly where the variant is meant to be seamless; it now paints in ground="affix" and starts at the bar's alpha. ChatWidget's body hand-rolled a 48px two-stop ramp shown whenever the body could scroll, so it kept covering the last message after the reader had scrolled to it; it is now a Fade bound to the scroller (data-slot chat-widget-fade kept).
